title: Statehood
description: Nebraska achieved statehood 1867 (37th). The road to statehood ran through territorial government, population thresholds, and a congressional enabling act — the standard American path. Corn and cattle; College World Series. Statehood Day is still celebrated, and the admission order gives Nebraska its number among the states.

title: Capital: Lincoln
d: Lincoln is the capital of Nebraska.

description: Lincoln has been the seat of Nebraska government, home to the capitol building, the supreme court, and the legislature. Capitals are often not the biggest city — Nebraska's largest is Omaha — chosen instead for geography or politics. Visit the capitol: the building itself tells the state's story in stone.
